items.title: Tesla reports Q3 operating volumes; earnings scheduled October 21
items.fact: Tesla reported production of 464,391 passenger vehicles, deliveries of 486,532, and 13.7 GWh of energy storage deployments. Its October 2 8-K furnishes the release; Q3 financial results and the webcast are scheduled for October 21.
items.interpretation: Issuer-level context for the autonomy coverage universe, not evidence of Optimus sales, robotaxi deployments, capital expenditure, or quarterly profitability. The release explicitly limits vehicle counts to passenger vehicles sold to customers. No capital event is classified.
items.transcriptStatus: October 21 call is future as of this review; transcript unavailable

items.title: Equinix and CPP Investments report completed atNorth acquisition
items.fact: The corrected September 2 release reports completion of the US$4 billion atNorth acquisition. Equinix's approximately 34% interest carries a US$895 million commitment. The release separately describes a US$4.1 billion financing package for the transaction and business expansion.
items.interpretation: Historical backfill discovered October 4; candidate M&A classification pending human review. Completion is issuer-reported, while the financing package is not proof that all funds have been drawn or deployed. Neither total transaction value nor financing equals Equinix-only capital expenditure. Supplier relationships are unchanged.
items.sourceTitle: Equinix corrected September 2 atNorth completion release
items.transcriptStatus: Transaction release; no associated transcript verified

items.title: Oracle reports Q1 FY2027 cloud infrastructure growth
items.fact: Oracle reported $7.4 billion in cloud infrastructure revenue, up 121% in USD, and $664 billion in remaining performance obligations. The issuer also reported completing $20 billion of common-stock sales before commissions through its ATM program.
items.interpretation: RPO represents future contracted revenue, not current revenue or cash. The equity sales are reported as completed; this earnings record does not approve a capital-event classification.
items.sourceTitle: Oracle September 10 Q1 FY2027 earnings release
items.transcriptStatus: Webcast referenced by issuer; transcript not verified

items.title: Australian AI infrastructure expansion targets up to 2 GW
items.fact: NVIDIA announced collaboration with Australian cloud and infrastructure partners to expand land, power, and shell capacity for DSX AI factories, targeting up to a 2-gigawatt buildout by 2027.
items.interpretation: Candidate expansion event pending review. The capacity is an announced target, not confirmation of operating capacity, completed construction, or NVIDIA capital expenditure. Supplier relationships have not been changed.
items.transcriptStatus: Press release; no associated earnings transcript verified

items.title: Oracle FY2026 results: cloud infrastructure and funding disclosures
items.fact: Oracle reported Q4 cloud infrastructure revenue of $5.8 billion and remaining performance obligations of $638 billion. It reported $43 billion of debt and $5 billion of equity financing raised in FY2026, while approximately $40 billion of FY2027 financing was an expectation.
items.interpretation: Historical earnings coverage added September 8. RPO is contracted future revenue, not current revenue or cash received. Completed financing and expected future financing must be tracked separately; no capital-event approval is implied.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Q2 FY2027 results
items.fact: NVIDIA reported Data Center revenue of $89.0 billion for Q2 FY2027, up 117% year over year.
items.interpretation: This supplies operating evidence for the compute layer. Revenue growth alone does not establish any particular customer's capital spending.
items.transcriptStatus: Issuer-hosted corrected August 26 transcript located; supply-constraint and outlook passages reviewed September 8

items.title: Microsoft publishes FY2026 Q4 earnings materials
items.fact: Microsoft's official earnings page provides the quarterly release, financial statements, and earnings-related downloads.
items.interpretation: Review cash purchases of property and equipment separately from finance leases before classifying a capital-expenditure event.
items.transcriptStatus: Transcript listed in earnings materials; contents not yet reviewed

items.title: Teradyne files second-quarter earnings exhibit
items.fact: The earnings release dated July 28 reports $100 million of Robotics revenue for Q2 2026. The issuer's SEC filing archive lists the exhibit under a July 29 8-K.
items.interpretation: The segment disclosure helps track commercial robotics demand. It does not identify individual robot orders or prove a backlog increase.
items.transcriptStatus: Webcast referenced in release; transcript not verified

items.title: AI infrastructure financing platform announcement
items.fact: NVIDIA's earnings release describes partnerships intended to mobilize third-party capital for AI infrastructure, subject to definitive agreements.
items.interpretation: Candidate financing event. Announced mobilization targets are not completed funding, deployed capital, or NVIDIA capital expenditures.
items.sourceTitle: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings release — Data Center highlights

items.title: Franklin Templeton marks five years of BENJI tokenized money fund
items.fact: Franklin says FOBXX uses a public blockchain as its official system of record and that BENJI represents fund shares with peer-to-peer transferability on enabled networks.
items.interpretation: This is evidence of live tokenized-fund infrastructure and operating adoption, not proof that all fund assets or settlement have moved on-chain.
items.sourceTitle: Franklin Templeton / Stellar BENJI anniversary release

items.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash-management products
items.fact: BlackRock announced tokenized money-market products and described token minting, burning, and transfer processes tied to fund records.
items.interpretation: This supports a tokenized-cash product signal. It does not by itself establish secondary-market liquidity, institutional scale, or a completed settlement-network contract.
items.sourceTitle: BlackRock Cash Management tokenized products release
